summary: The Paleobiology Database holds fossil occurrences with environment and age, including freshwater (lacustrine and fluvial) versus marine and terrestrial counts, which supports origination/extinction comparisons; for living lineages, FishBase gives freshwater/marine flags, and the Fish Tree of Life plus one Sahul dataset give dated fish trees, but no source joins habitat, lineage age and rates across realms beyond fishes.
next_step: Pre-register a fossil-only test (per-realm origination/extinction from PBDB with sampling standardisation) and a fish-only test (FishBase habitat joined to the Fish Tree of Life); decide a relict criterion separately.
obstacles_confirmed: Freshwater fossils are preserved less completely than marine shelly faunas.
Relict is a judgment about morphological oddity as well as phylogenetic age.
Habitat shifts move lineages across the categories being compared.
